item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01625","case1_error":"Treats 90 seconds per ear as 90 seconds for both ears, omitting one ear's cleaning time.","case2_error":"Adds the senior discount back after correctly subtracting it, undoing the discount.","reason":"The first omits a required multiplicity; the second reverses a correctly applied discount with an extra addition.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01626","case1_error":"Uses 3 grams per smaller antacid instead of the stated 1 gram.","case2_error":"Treats the average as the total and makes the second dog's intake double the third's instead of the first's.","reason":"The first substitutes an incorrect unit weight; the second misrepresents both the average-to-total relationship and the doubling relationship.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01627","case1_error":"Subtracts six inches from rim height instead of adding six inches to establish the required reach.","case2_error":"Evaluates the correctly written subtraction 140 − 85 as 45 instead of 55.","reason":"The first uses an erroneous target-height relation; the second makes a numerical evaluation error in a correct expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01628","case1_error":"Equates Roger's current experience with the retirement threshold, ignoring Tom's stated experience relationship.","case2_error":"Evaluates 1000 − 400 − 375 as 200 instead of 225.","reason":"The first imposes an unjustified equation for current experience; the second incorrectly evaluates a correctly formulated remainder.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01629","case1_error":"Reduces the required rope length by 25% instead of accounting for loss in the purchased rope's usable length.","case2_error":"Counts two three-foot gates plus the ten-foot gate, introducing an extra three-foot gate.","reason":"The first applies the loss factor to the wrong quantity; the second double-counts a gate.","judgment":"different"}]}
